interface.shortDescription: Names and domains you can buy
interface.longDescription:
It checks the domain, the cheapest shop including renewal, the app stores and US trademarks, in one answer. Free.

Use this when you want to know if a domain is available and where it is cheapest, or when you need a good name for your business and have none yet. Domain Hound checks ten endings (.com, .ai, .io, .dev, .app, .co, .so, .sh, .tech, .inc) and finds the cheapest of six shops, renewal included. It shows the first-year price, renewal price and total cost over three years, and suggests cheaper endings. If your name is taken, it helps you find names with a meaning behind them, each with an available domain. It also checks app names on the App Store and Google Play, shows exact US trademark matches only, and shows other businesses found using the name. Similar names aren't checked for trademarks.

Never buys without your yes. With your Spaceship key and your yes, your agent can buy it and set up DNS. Approve the exact price through Spaceship’s own MCP. Direct purchase is an opt-in, and Spaceship checkout is the fallback. Dated list prices, source shown. Trademark results are a search aid, not legal advice.

Works in your agent (Claude Code and Codex). Made by BrightBoard AS. Privacy policy https://domainhound.dev/privacy/ and terms of service https://domainhound.dev/terms/ Support is available through GitHub Issues or privacy@domainhound.dev.
